description: ST VL53L0X — I2C time-of-flight ranging sensor, up to 2m range, 940nm VCSEL. LGA-12 package. Measures distance regardless of target reflectance. Eye-safe Class 1 laser.
name: vl53l0x
watch_out_for: 2.6-3.5V supply. XSHUT must be pulled high to run; keep the optical window unobstructed (no mask/silk/parts in front).
